name: wildwood_scourge_sees_a_raider_enter_with_a_counter
notes: Bug hunt 2026-11-17 (hunt 5 H5-2). Wildwood Scourge: 'Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on another non-Hydra creature you control, put a +1/+1 counter on Wildwood Scourge.' After P0 attacked (the Attacker deals 1), Goblin Boarders enters with a +1/+1 counter (raid). CR 122.6: counters put on a creature as it enters are put on it, so the Scourge gets one: 2 + 1 = 3. Failed before the fix: the raid counter (EtBState) was added with no journal row (2 counters).
